blocks.text: A former fishing village about 170 km east of Rio, Búzios has an intimate feel, a mild climate, exotic vegetation and picture-perfect beaches, with golden sands, crystal-clear water, green hills, rocky cliffs and beautiful sunsets. Besides relaxing by the sea, surfing, scuba diving, water-skiing and kayaking are popular; a boat trip with a local fisherman reveals turtles, tropical fish and, in season, even whales. In the evening, chic restaurants and stylish bars open their doors along the cobbled streets: the perfect family spot to unwind after your Brazilian journey.
